36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
335929: Yuu is a 17-year-old boy with a short stature. He possesses striking red hair and red eyes. Despite being described as average, his most notable feature is his handsome and beautiful face, which he inherited from his mother, Subaru Ayase.
335930: Miwa is the youngest of the Mikadono Sisters. She is a high school girl with a unique two-tone short cut, with the top of her head being blonde and the rest of her hair being green. Like her sisters, she also has golden eyes.
335931: Kazuki is the eldest of the Mikadono Sisters. She possesses outstanding acting and singing skills, capable of flawlessly portraying roles that are deemed impossible by others, and she also has incredible ticket-selling power, as every performance she appears in is sold out.
335932: Niko is the second eldest of the Mikadono Sisters. Despite her small stature of 150cm, Niko is a karate athlete who overwhelms her opponents with immense strength, winning numerous medals.
373702: Patriarch of the Mikadono household, Mr. Mikadono raised his three daughters under a strict regimen to bring out the best of their abilities. Subaru Ayase is an old friend of his, and because he was indebted to her in the past, he takes in her son Yuu after her passing.
373703: An immensely successful actress, Subaru Ayase was lauded as immensely talented in any field she tried her hand at. Unfortunately, her prestige came at a price, as she was unable to spend time with her son Yuu due to her work.
373958: A third year student at Iwayama High, Hayato Tatsumi is known as a genius karateka and Niko Mikadono's senpai.
373959: Sakura Yaotome is a first-year high schooler and Miwa Mikadono's self-proclaimed rival in shogi. Unlike other shogi players, who became prodigies, Sakura was a novice who only became skilled at the game through hard work and perseverance.
